title: Business Central Mirroring to Microsoft Fabric FAQ

facts.text: Public preview. Business Central online version 29.1 or later with Mirroring to Fabric extension required.
Available for Business Central online only, not on-premises or Docker environments.
Workspace assigned to active Fabric capacity or supported Fabric trial. Paused capacity stops replication.
MS Fabric Mirroring - Admin to configure, Activate to manage packages, Read for synchronization monitoring.
Mirroring copies initial data then syncs changes. Use when API refreshes are slow or combining data from multiple systems.
Up to 1,000 selected tables across manual selections and packages. FlowFields and BLOB fields excluded.
Cannot filter records, specify time periods, choose individual fields, or configure different intervals per table.
No Business Central fee for mirroring. Fabric doesn't charge replication compute but charges for storage beyond free allowance and queries.
